from collections import deque

def aho_corasick(patterns={{patterns}}, text={{text}}):
    trie = [{}]
    fail = [0]
    out = [[]]
    for i, p in enumerate(patterns):
        node = 0
        for c in p:
            if c not in trie[node]:
                trie.append({}); fail.append(0); out.append([])
                trie[node][c] = len(trie)-1
            node = trie[node][c]
        out[node].append(i)
    q = deque()
    for c, nxt in trie[0].items():
        fail[nxt] = 0; q.append(nxt)
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        for c, v in trie[u].items():
            f = fail[u]
            while f and c not in trie[f]: f = fail[f]
            fail[v] = trie[f].get(c, 0) if trie[f].get(c, 0) != v else 0
            out[v] += out[fail[v]]
            q.append(v)
    matches = []; node = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(text):
        while node and c not in trie[node]: node = fail[node]
        node = trie[node].get(c, 0)
        for pid in out[node]:
            matches.append((i - len(patterns[pid]) + 1, pid))
    return matches
